full_judgment: 2. Plaintiff respondent No.1 filed the aforesaid suit for a decree for declaration that the order of temporary suspension dated 4.10.96 issued by the Chairman of the Governing Body of Al-haj B.N. Khan(Degree) College, Uzirpur, Barisal and the two memos dated 14.7,97 and 15.7.97 are unlawful, fraudulent, without jurisdiction, null and void and not binding upon the plaintiff. The plaint case is that the plaintiff while acting as the principal of the college, an internal audit team was set up by the Governing body to enquire into certain allegations and the audit team found misappropriation of an amount of Tk. 2,80,670/- from the college fund by the plaintiff. Thereafter the plaintiff was temporarily suspended from the post of Principal without issuing any prior show cause notice and to that effect the suspension order is bad.
